routes.label: Recover each whole from its fractional part

question: At Olympic High School, \(\tfrac25\) of the freshmen and \(\tfrac45\) of the sophomores took the AMC \(10.\) Given that the number of freshmen and sophomore contestants was the same, which of the following must be true?
solution:
Let \(c\) be the number of contestants from each class, and let \(F\) and \(S\) be the total numbers of freshmen and sophomores. Dividing the contestant count by the fraction that participated recovers the whole class:
\[
\begin{aligned}
F&=c\div\frac25=\frac{5c}{2},\\
S&=c\div\frac45=\frac{5c}{4}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(\frac{5c}{2}=2\left(\frac{5c}{4}\right)\), we have \(F=2S\). There are twice as many freshmen as sophomores, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
